{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuat Central Authority''' was a security force that monitored the starships going to and from the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] in orbit of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The organization also controlled traffic to the planet itself.
